\noindent Gate probabilities use 100 training-system bootstrap refits per corpus. Shapley medians, percentile ranges, and positive frequencies use all 50 complete training-system bootstrap games per corpus, conditional on the fixed observed test set. These are descriptive stability summaries, not precise 95\% confidence intervals or joint training/test uncertainty. Positive frequency has resolution 1/50. LOO is signed test MSE without the representation minus full-model test MSE. Negative LOO means removal improves test MSE; it is not zero utility.
